notes.title: 📷💥 0.13.0 "TECHNOLOGICAL DIFFICULTIES" UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33014119/cb1bbe607d5cf9a4d00557cc29fd1e54c6a74454.png[/img]

We have updated The Spy Who Shrunk Me to version 0.13.0 with the new "Technological Difficulties" Update!

[b]DUE TO POPULAR DEMAND: DIFFICULTY LEVELS![/b]
Choose from Casual, Normal or Superspy to play YOUR way. We'll adjust the experience based on your choice - enemies detect you faster on higher difficulties, alarms last longer and there are more traps about!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33014119/d1762bea2976a3ab7e3ae561972ba27cdb32a929.png[/img]

[b]NEW OBSTACLES: CAMERAS AND LASER WALLS[/b]
Each level has new obstacles in the form of cameras and laser walls. This should make the game considerably harder on higher difficulties. Lower difficulties have less of these obstacles that require you to use the Shrink Ray and Teleporter to get past them. You'll encounter the first of Cameras and Laser Walls in "Software Company Shenanigans" and onwards.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33014119/452a3c8e991e08a573d0b8509215ce34cb8d617f.png[/img]

[b]CODEX - YOUR LORE HANDBOOK[/b]
Starting now, the main menu and pause menu has a handy dandy Codex that tells you where you can find lore item pickups! Later on, we'll expand this to include information about the world and characters of The Spy Who Shrunk Me.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33014119/f4a14bad66fd0a8c306ac701fc5c73ce80546d99.png[/img]

[b]COMING LATER THIS MONTH: VIRTUAL REALITY[/b]
We thought you'd enjoy this update first while we use some much needed polish time on the upcoming Virtual Reality edition. The game will work on all SteamVR headsets - and due to a few funny last minute issues, we wanted to push this update out first. Keep an eye out a little bit later in April for the debut of our Virtual Reality edition. We'll do our best to get it out to you as soon as we think it'll be the best it can be!

Here's the full patch notes for your enjoyment.

[b]General[/b]
- New feature: Codex! It will tell you where you can find the lore item collectibles. Later on, it will give you exciting lore tidbits.
- Added obstacles: Security Cameras and Laser Walls to all but three levels (not included in "Rails to Russia", "Virtual Insanity" or "Sayonara, Smoothspy!")
- Added difficulty levels, with differing enemy and trap spawns in different difficulties. On Easy difficulty it takes longer for enemies to detect you, with Superspy difficulty doing the exact opposite. Also made changes to "Sayonara, Smoothspy!" time limit depending on difficulty.
- Fixed some objects that showed a pick up prompt even when the item wasn't supposed to be picked up
- A cocktail of bug fixes, performance improvements and other cool backend stuff

[b]Beyond the Books[/b]
- Minor fixes to props and prop placement
- The enemy holding the key is now somewhat randomized between few possible choices

[b]A Mind of Madness[/b]
- Added an info notification that tells you that the scientists in the laboratories are friendly

[b]Virtual Insanity[/b]
- Added new dialogue
- Fixed a bug with certain prop audio volumes in the mission not respecting player audio settings 

Onwards with the roadmap, which will next feature the Virtual Reality edition, an all new mission and our way out of Early Access!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33014119/5e684ab642a1d1a880f69b787f4ab09cb844e85b.png[/img]

Break a leg,
Tomi Toikka
CEO
Catland

You can now visit Audrey Smoothspy's British bungalow home equipped with extremely comfortable furniture and a hidden spybase behind a bookcase!

Can you find all ten? We've hidden an amazing assortment of trinkets across all the missions in the game. There's two new achievements for finding one or all the collectibles. Some are in pretty hard spots, so get your thinking caps on.

notes.title: 🕶📉 0.11.0 THE CORPORATE TRANSPARENCY UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33014119/cd1b45a1a050fc321782ba7e250c0db6f77293af.png[/img]

We have updated The Spy Who Shrunk Me to version 0.11.0 with the new Corporate Transparency Update!

[b]THE SPYTACLES[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33014119/1331af8307e7645a7a91fae04c0d69b254884016.gif[/img]

See enemies through walls with the handy dandy Spytacles! With 20 seconds of wallhacking fun and two per mission, this should help you in a tough spot. It's especially useful when trying to evade guards trying to find you. Mix this with the Stopwatch and you can truly evade enemy patrols.

You can pick up the Spytacles in the "Mind of Madness" mission.

[b]EXPANDED MISSIONS[/b]
The "Mind of Madness" and "Mind of Madness, Redux" missions have been updated with more stealth action, greatly expanding the laboratories and beyond. Additionally, all levels have been updated with Spytacles and Stopwatch pickups!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33014119/6b806e81d756472d682d54f1fa2d515942e1a0e4.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33014119/b4ab1af8a3fb4f3413f6b66f49acef55a9c93704.jpg[/img]

[b]BUG FIXES AND PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
As always, we fixed everything™ from minor visual glitches to bigger things like saves not functioning correctly.

Here's the full patch notes for your enjoyment.

[b]General[/b]
- Added new tutorial video for the Stopwatch
- Flipped viewmodels for Stopwatch and Spytacles
- Added FIVR and Mikko Juutinen to the credits
- Minor savegame fixes

[b]Operation Improbable[/b]
Thanks Pungence for bringing these to attention!

- Fixed colliders
- Fixed floating objects
- Blocked a path through the first lasers which was not supposed to be there
- Added an effect and a sound when opening the blast doors

[b]A Mind of Madness[/b]
- Added a new gadget, Spytacles, which allows you to see enemies through walls! Use this to your advantage to better plan your routes and slip through
undetected. The effect only lasts for 20 seconds per use, so plan your usage carefully!
- Expanded the whole level roughly 50% to be more in line with original design intentions and to give you opportunities to test out
the new gadget.

[b]Beyond the Books[/b]
- Added Spytacles pickups
- Fixed minor lighting Issues

[b]Artificial Insanity[/b]
- Added Spytacles pickups

[b]A Mind of Madness, Redux[/b]
- Expanded the level, again, roughly 50% with the addition of an exquisite lobby bar after the laboratory portion of the level

[b]Person of Importance[/b]
- Fixed colliders
- Fixed pathfinding issues
- Added two more enemy guards and associated patrol routes

[b]Rocket Jockey[/b]
- Added Spytacles pickups
- Added three guards and associated patrol routes to otherwise barren locations
- Fixed texture errors
- Resolved large pathfinding issues around the rocket and a few smaller ones elsewhere
- Fixed colliders

[b]SLIGHT ROADMAP ADJUSTMENTS[/b]
We're a team of six and our future schedule got a bit bouncy due to us going to GDC in March! 

So we're moving the new mission to [i]after[/i] the VR version. So "Quaternion Identity", the new mission, will come now in April instead of March. As we said before, the roadmap might get changed a bit so we hope you don't mind this necessary change.

Stay tuned for the end of the month where we'll have Audrey's home base & collectibles!

VR version is still on schedule for next month! We're really excited to get you playing that.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33014119/5e684ab642a1d1a880f69b787f4ab09cb844e85b.png[/img]

Have a blast,
Tomi Toikka
CEO
Catland

notes.title: 📌THE SPY WHO SHRUNK ME VERSION 0.9.1 PATCH NOTES
notes.notes:
We have updated The Spy Who Shrunk Me to version 0.9.1!

[b]New Gameplay Features[/b]
- Added a new non-lethal way to eliminate guards! You can now drop enemies in trash bins - we've added green trash bins to all the current campaign levels. This counts as a pacifist way to dispose of enemies when you've shrunk them!

[b]Audio[/b]
- Sound effects should now properly react to all volume changes through the Options menu

[b]Detection[/b]
- The game will no longer generate a checkpoint if guards know your position

[b]Shrink Ray[/b]
- Fixed an issue with crouching while shrunk
- Fixed accuracy problems with the Shrink Ray

[b]Airbag Mines[/b]
- Made it easier to place airbag mines

[b]Guards[/b]
- Minor fixes to enemy detection

[b]Rails To Russia[/b]
- Added new props to the train 
- More texture variety 
- Small changes to guard patrol routes
- Fixed some cases where it was possible to get out of bounds

[b]A Mind of Madness[/b]
- Fixed problem that occurs when dealing with Eierkopf after reloading a checkpoint
- An experiment has gotten loose in the labs under the floor grates

[b]Beyond the Books[/b]
- The guard with the key will drop the key properly now when using banana peels or airbag mines

[b]Artificial Insanity[/b]
- Added trash cans and paper shredders to the level

[b]A Mind of Madness, Redux[/b]

notes.title: 🍻🎈 v1.0 AND THE SPY WHO SHILLED ME UPDATE NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30561512/23944f67eeab2769b94180ff41390a80fe2a3ba3.png[/img]

[h1][b]Taphouse VR stumbles out of Early Access with huge new content update![/b][/h1]
We'd like to thank all of our players so much for helping us out on our journey with Taphouse VR! We've shipped so many content updates to our game we decided to get out of Early Access with a bang - a new tavern, new achievements and various quality of life improvements you have asked. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30561512/5d1438b521c6547701646068218710ef64bfa39d.png[/img]

[h1][b]TAPHOUSE VR: THE SPY WHO SHILLED ME UPDATE[/b][/h1]
- Added an all-new tavern, the Moscow Express! You are the bartender in a restaurant train car - a level straight out of our upcoming title [b]The Spy Who Shrunk Me[/b]!
- Three new music tracks composed by Oskar Nieminen for the new tavern, straight out of The Spy Who Shrunk Me!
- Added manual reorientation feature so you can rotate your playspace from the options menu meant especially for our WMR customers
- Redecorated the Home Hub to include new goodies such as a Dopefish and an entrance to our new tavern
- Two new achievements: watch the trailer for our new game and finish a shift at the new tavern to achieve them!
- New things to throw around such as books and postcards!
- Various fixes and performance improvements

[h1]This update celebrates our upcoming game [b]The Spy Who Shrunk Me[/b]![/h1]
Our next game for both PC & VR is the exciting stealth adventure The Spy Who Shrunk Me - become a superspy with a shrink ray and some banana peels to save the free world from a threat that is going to turn the Cold War into a fiery one.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/754850/The_Spy_Who_Shrunk_Me/

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z2TVmnaj-M8&feature=youtu.be
The Spy Who Shrunk Me is coming later 2018 for both PC and VR on Steam - be sure to wishlist and follow to get the latest news!

[h1]The future of Taphouse[/h1]
We can't promise anything yet, but after The Spy Who Shrunk Me we might have something cool going on that Taphouse fans will love. We'll keep you posted.

Keep on keeping on & stay beautiful,
Tomi Toikka
CEO
Catland
